entities.name: Calvin
entities.description: A rapper and musician who moved into a mansion in Japan in spring 2023, toured and recorded with Frank Ocean, released an album on 11 September 2023, and moved between Japan, Tokyo and Boston through the year. He owns a red Ferrari, a custom octopus guitar and a diamond necklace, and converted his mansion into a recording studio. He told Dave on 9 June 2023 that he had never been to Boston, called Boston home on 31 May 2023, and said on 29 October 2023 that he had been there a few years earlier.

entities.name: Dave
entities.description: An automotive engineer and classic-car restorer living in Boston. He opened his own car maintenance shop in May 2023, joined a rock band in June 2023, was selected for a car modification workshop in San Francisco in August 2023, took up photography in October 2023 and started a blog about car modifications in November 2023. He is Calvin's friend and the other speaker throughout.

entities.name: Frank Ocean
entities.description: A well-known musician Calvin toured and recorded with through 2023. Calvin gave two incompatible accounts of when they met: a music festival in Tokyo (told on 22 August 2023) and a festival in August 2022 (told on 19 October 2023).

entities.name: Dave's father
entities.description: Dave's father, who took Dave to his first car show when Dave was ten and spent a summer of Dave's childhood restoring an old car with him. Dave spent hours tinkering with engines in his garage as a boy, which he calls his sanctuary.

entities.name: Calvin's father
entities.description: Calvin's father, with whom Calvin took a childhood road trip during which they sang California Love by Tupac and Dr. Dre.

entities.name: Calvin's old high school friend

properties.aliases: a high school friend; my old high school buddy

entities.description: A friend of Calvin's from high school, based in or near Boston, with whom he freestyled and talked about getting famous as a teenager. Calvin visited Boston sights with him on 24 October 2023 and invited him to a Boston performance in November 2023; the two mentions are recorded as one person because both describe a Boston high school friend who has supported Calvin from the start.

entities.name: Tupac
entities.description: Rapper, one of the two artists behind California Love, the song Calvin and his father sang on a childhood road trip.

entities.name: Dr. Dre
entities.description: Producer and rapper, one of the two artists behind California Love, the song Calvin and his father sang on a childhood road trip.

entities.name: Japan
entities.description: The country Calvin moved to in spring 2023, where his mansion and his home studio are. He had never been before March 2023 and was fascinated by its traditions, culture and food; he collaborated with Japanese artists and said in September 2023 he longed to go back. Dave had never visited as of October 2023 but wanted to.

entities.name: Tokyo
entities.description: Japanese city where Calvin attended a music festival in April 2023, performed on the Frank Ocean tour, photographed the skyline on the night of 15 May 2023, and planned to return in November 2023 to see Shibuya Crossing and Shinjuku. Dave had never been as of October 2023 but wanted to go.

entities.name: Boston
entities.description: The city Dave lives in, where his shop, his parks, his rock concerts and his photography subjects are. Dave named Paradise Rock, House of Blues and Fenway Park as its music venues. Calvin planned a visit from March 2023 onwards, met artists there on 3 October 2023, saw the sights on 24 October 2023, attended a gala on 16 November 2023 and accepted a forthcoming performance there.

entities.name: Miami
entities.description: The city where Calvin shot the video for his new album on a beach chosen for its visuals, starting the weekend of 26-27 August 2023.

entities.name: San Francisco
entities.description: The city where Dave attended a car restoration and modification workshop in August 2023; he returned to Boston from a visit there on 1 September 2023 with new knowledge about car modification.

entities.name: Detroit
entities.description: The city where Dave attended a conference shortly before 25 October 2023, at which he said he learned a lot.

entities.name: Shibuya Crossing
entities.description: A Tokyo landmark Calvin likened to Times Square and was excited to visit on his November 2023 trip.

entities.name: Shinjuku
entities.description: A Tokyo district Calvin said he was excited to explore on his November 2023 trip.

entities.name: Calvin's Japanese mansion

properties.aliases: my new mansion; my Japanese mansion; my Japanese house; such a nice place

entities.description: The mansion in Japan Calvin moved into in spring 2023, found for him by his agent. It has a city-skyline view, a backyard, a relaxation room with a television, and the recording studio Calvin built inside it, where he recorded with Frank Ocean. He threw an album party there in the week before 2 November 2023.

entities.name: Dave's favourite park

properties.aliases: this beautiful park; that spot; a nearby park; my favorite

entities.description: A park with a lake and boats near Dave in Boston, where he walks to relax. He recommended it to Calvin in March 2023, arranged regular walks there with friends from July 2023, and photographed a waterfall at a serene spot in it in November 2023. Calvin, who had never been in March 2023, took the advice and visited it by 25 October 2023.

entities.name: Dave's car maintenance shop
entities.description: The car maintenance shop Dave opened in May 2023 and calls a dream come true. He works on everything there from routine maintenance to full classic-car restorations. In the week before 15 October 2023 a competing shop won a deal his had chased for months, which left him discouraged.

entities.name: Dave's rock band
entities.description: The rock band Dave joined shortly before 21 June 2023, having been a fan of it for years. He plays guitar with them, they had a jam session on the night of 14 September 2023 that they enjoyed too much to record, and they created a guitar logo.

entities.name: Car modification workshop

properties.aliases: car mod workshop; a car workshop in San Francisco

entities.description: The car modification and restoration workshop in San Francisco Dave was selected for in August 2023. There he did engine swaps and suspension modifications and was learning body modification, giving a classic muscle car a modern silver finish.

entities.name: Aerosmith
entities.description: The band Dave named as his favourite act at the Boston music festival of 18-19 March 2023; it was the first time he had seen them live, and he did not meet them afterwards. Calvin also said he liked them.

entities.name: The Fireworks
entities.description: The band that headlined the music festival Dave returned from shortly before 15 October 2023.

entities.name: Calvin's album
entities.description: The album Calvin worked on through 2023: a long creative-team session on 8 June 2023, a video shot on a Miami beach from the weekend of 26-27 August 2023, release on 11 September 2023 to a reception he found overwhelming, and a launch party at his Japanese mansion in the week before 2 November 2023. On 29 October 2023 he described his album as almost finished, which does not square with the September release.

entities.name: Ratatouille
entities.description: The Disney film Calvin named on 15 September 2023 as one of his favourites, for its lesson about going after what you love whatever others say; Dave said it is one of his favourite Disney films too.

entities.name: California Love
entities.description: The Tupac and Dr. Dre song that played on a road trip Calvin took with his father as a child; Calvin said on 22 September 2023 that it still makes him smile.

entities.name: Calvin's red Ferrari
entities.description: The red luxury sports car Calvin bought in late March 2023 and identified as a Ferrari in August 2023. He drove it on 25 March 2023, crashed it on 16 June 2023, had it repaired by 7 July 2023 and serviced shortly before 3 August 2023. On 15 October 2023 he said he had got a new Ferrari the week before, shown in a photograph as black, which may be a second car.

entities.name: Calvin's octopus guitar
entities.description: A guitar custom-made for Calvin by a Japanese artist friend, decorated with an octopus standing for his love of art and the sea and finished with a shiny purple sheen to suit his style. One of his favourite possessions and, he says, a reminder of his passion for music and the friendships he has made.

entities.name: Calvin's diamond necklace
entities.description: A gold necklace with a diamond pendant given to Calvin by another artist, which he keeps as a reminder of why he keeps working as a musician.

entities.name: Dave's vintage camera
entities.description: The vintage camera Dave bought in November 2023, which he says captures special moments very clearly; he uses it to photograph nature.

entities.name: Car restoration and modification
entities.description: Restoring, fixing and modifying cars. Dave's lifelong craft, begun at ten when he asked to fix an old car in a neighbour's garage, continued with his father and now his trade; he calls it therapy, an outlet and a way of giving something a second chance. Calvin also says fixing cars calms him and gives him a sense of achievement.

entities.name: Photography
entities.description: The hobby Dave took up shortly before 29 October 2023. He photographs the Boston skyline, a city clock tower at sunset, and nature - sunsets, beaches, waves and a waterfall in a park near him - and calls it a creative outlet that helps him appreciate beauty.

entities.name: Calvin's mansion recording studio
entities.description: Calvin's project to turn his Japanese mansion into a recording studio, a long-held dream of having a space to make music with other artists. He showed its progress on 21 July 2023, recorded a song with Frank Ocean in it, makes beats for young artists there, and uses it only for work, keeping a separate room with a television to relax in. He calls it his creative haven and his sanctuary.

entities.name: Calvin's tour with Frank Ocean
entities.description: The tour Calvin performed on with Frank Ocean. He reported a Tokyo date on 31 May 2023, said on 22 August 2023 that the tour would end soon and on 31 August 2023 that it had ended, then said on 19 October 2023 that he had started touring with Frank Ocean, with the tour still running on 23 October 2023 and due to end before a November 2023 Tokyo trip. The conversation contradicts itself about when it ran.

entities.name: Dave's vintage Mustang restoration
entities.description: Dave's restoration of a vintage Ford Mustang he found in bad shape in a junkyard. He hoped on 14 August 2023 to finish by the end of September, showed a finished result on 15 September 2023, hit an unexplained engine noise on 22 September 2023, showed the restored car on 4 October 2023 and said on 29 October 2023 that he had just finished it. Recorded as one project because every mention describes the same junkyard Mustang.

entities.name: Dave's car modification blog
entities.description: The blog about car modifications Dave started shortly before 2 November 2023 to share his passion. Readers write to him for advice, and a post about making a car look like a beast inspired others to start their own DIY projects.
